entries.title: Iran killed her teenage daughter - now she is facing up to the regime
entries.snippet: Samira's 16-year-old daughter Sevda was shot dead as they took part in mass protests in January.

entries.title: Supermarket freezers in Belgium, Sweden and Luxembourg hit by suspected cyber-attack
entries.snippet: Stores in Sweden say temperatures for its freezers were raised to 50 C (122F).

entries.title: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street
entries.snippet: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash, which happened near President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort, as a "horrific tragedy".

entries.title: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured
entries.snippet: The attack on Donovan Marx, 50, comes as right-wing groups say there is a genocide of white people - a claim widely discredited.

entries.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
entries.snippet: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

entries.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
entries.snippet: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.

entries.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
entries.snippet: The country was the first to contribute troops to the AU mission established to stabilise Somalia in 2007.

entries.title: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
entries.snippet: China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last.

entries.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
entries.snippet: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.

entries.title: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
entries.snippet: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.

entries.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
entries.snippet: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

entries.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
entries.snippet: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

entries.title: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
entries.snippet: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.

entries.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
entries.snippet: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

entries.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
entries.snippet: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

entries.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
entries.snippet: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.

entries.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book
entries.snippet: Trump had sued the media outlet after it published a letter to Epstein purportedly written and signed by the president as part of a birthday book.

entries.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
entries.snippet: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

entries.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
entries.snippet: The incumbent Republican running for re-election and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting a second Dan Sullivan to also stand in the race.

entries.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
entries.snippet: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people have contracted the rare virus.

entries.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
entries.snippet: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

entries.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
entries.snippet: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

entries.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
entries.snippet: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

entries.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
entries.snippet: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

entries.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
entries.snippet: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

entries.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
entries.snippet: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

entries.title: What Vance's midterm push reveals about his potential 2028 bid
entries.snippet: Vance's delivery is different from the president's but his speeches contain plenty of MAGA DNA.

entries.title: Morning news brief
entries.snippet: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan race, key races remain close in last day before midterm election, Gulf states concerned about possible U.S. attack on Iran.

entries.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
entries.snippet: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

entries.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
entries.snippet: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.

entries.title: Justice Department urges sanctions for database analysis critical of its noncitizen voting claims
entries.snippet: Attorneys for an immigrant rights group on Saturday filed court papers revealing that their analysis found more than 40% of the people on the list do not appear in the state's voter file.

entries.title: All 9 people aboard a jet that crashed in Florida have died, transportation secretary says
entries.snippet: The aircraft had departed Austin-Bergstrom International Airport in Texas and was headed to the Bahamas, according to the Federal Aviation Administration.

entries.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy is in the hospital after having a stroke, his office says
entries.snippet: Murphy's chief of staff, Allison Herwitt, said in a statement the 53-year-old senator "started experiencing numbness in his arm while at his son's hockey game" on Saturday.

entries.title: Israeli officials say elections will stand after Netanyahu claimed Arabs stole vote
entries.snippet: By casting doubt on the vote, Netanyahu appears to be trying to block any potential alliance in the opposition with the Arab parties that could force him from office.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump rallies in Iowa as part of final push before Election Day
entries.snippet: In Iowa, Trump insisted Republicans were on the verge of sweeping victories on Election Day on Tuesday. "We're going to elect 'America first' Republicans up and down the line," he said.

entries.title: Canada's Carney reports progress in trade talks with U.S. and Trump talks up 'concept' of a deal
entries.snippet: Carney said the conversation built on recent discussions about the outlines of a deal that would create jobs, lower costs for families and protect Canada's languages, culture and sovereignty.

entries.title: Shootings over Halloween weekend leave at least 6 dead and dozens injured across U.S.
entries.snippet: The deadliest violence occurred in Dallas, where a handful of shootings in the city's Deep Ellum neighborhood, a center of music, restaurants and nightlife, killed four people and injured 15 others, police said.

entries.title: El-Sayed's primary opponent stuns Democrats by endorsing Republican opponent in Michigan Senate race
entries.snippet: The remarkable show of support for the President Donald Trump-backed candidate in the tightly contested race comes after she was uninvited to a joint event the same day with El-Sayed, who defeated the congresswoman by a slim margin in the August primary.

entries.title: Judge dismisses lawsuit seeking to block certification of Alaska Senate race if GOP incumbent loses
entries.snippet: Tuesday's ranked-choice election includes two candidates who have done little campaigning, one of whom shares the incumbent's name. It was that candidate's presence on the ballot that prompted Trump to push for the lawsuit out of fear he would siphon votes from the incumbent.

entries.title: FBI says North Korea was behind $6.3 billion Binance heist, the biggest crypto hack in history
entries.snippet: The bureau said in a statement that the attack was tied to "malicious cyber activity" by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a $1.5 billion Bybit hack last year.

entries.title: ICE agent charged with assault for hitting fleeing man with car in Houston will turn himself in, attorney says
entries.snippet: Mario Alberto Morales, a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer, struck Miguel Parra Hernandez, a 48-year-old construction worker, with his unmarked SUV on Oct. 10, as he chased Parra Hernandez through a parking lot.

entries.title: Attorneys for Alaska say 'meritless' Trump demand to set aside Senate ballots 'not even possible'
entries.snippet: The Department of Justice on Friday added a request that the judge separate all ballots showing votes for the second Dan Sullivan until it can be determined whether voters were fooled into wasting their votes for a spoiler candidate.

entries.title: Paxton and Talarico tussle for Texas Senate seat as Trump campaigns virtually
entries.snippet: The closing sprint in Texas comes as early voting nears its conclusion in several states. Early balloting totals were approaching 50 million heading into the weekend. About 112 million voted in total in the 2022 midterm elections.

entries.title: Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday letter
entries.snippet: U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles in Miami dismissed the suit with prejudice, ruling that the president did not prove the defendants made defamatory statements with actual malice as required by law.

entries.title: Analysis: More than 40% of names on DOJ list of alleged noncitizens not on California's voter rolls
entries.snippet: It's the first outside analysis of a list that the Department of Justice has used to threaten prosecution of election officials. The analysis also found that thousands of U.S. citizens appear to be flagged as ineligible to vote on the government's list.

entries.title: FBI visits Dan J. Sullivan donor in candidate's hometown as Alaska Senate inquiry widens
entries.snippet: An Anchorage-based FBI agent visited a boat dealership in Petersburg, a small fishing community accessible only by air or water where the candidate lives.

entries.title: Virginia and D.C. sue over Trump's arch, adding to legal challenges as government wants work to begin
entries.snippet: There are now three lawsuits calling for a halt to potential work on a monument that would rise 250 feet on a patch of grass off the bridge that spans the Potomac River, connecting the city with Arlington National Cemetery.

entries.title: A third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
entries.snippet: About 70,000 police and gendarmes were deployed across the country after French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned of a "very high risk" of disorder, especially after dark on Halloween.

entries.title: When will we know 2026 midterm election results? It may take some time, but that's normal
entries.snippet: In past elections, elected leaders, candidates and social media users have spread falsehoods that "late night" arrivals of "ballot dumps" or "suitcases" of ballots are signs of fraud, or that only Democratic-led cities take days to count votes.

entries.title: Congo's Ebola deaths top 5,000 as fear of continent-wide spread mounts
entries.snippet: Data from the Congolese Ministry of Health showed that the disease has killed 5,026 people out of 10,351 infected, at a nearly 50% lethality rate.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Iliana Yotova wins the presidential election in Bulgaria, portraying herself as the 'president of peace'
entries.snippet: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.

entries.title: Will renewed conflict derail Ethiopia's economic growth?
entries.snippet: Ethiopia's economy is growing strongly. But renewed fighting in the north of the BRICS member state could deter investment, strain public finances and push up the cost of living.

entries.title: For US Democrats, climate policy is now about energy bills
entries.snippet: Climate change has all but disappeared from Democrats' campaign pitches, replaced by promises to lower electricity bills. But what would the party actually do on climate if it wins control of Congress?

entries.title: US: Nine killed in Florida jet crash
entries.snippet: A Learjet plane crashed near a busy road in a residential neighborhood in Palm Beach County, leaving all nine people on board dead and a large crater on ground.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin hosts digital summit with AI focus
entries.snippet: A government-run conference is to look at the uses and dangers of artificial intelligence. This comes as the German and UK defense ministers will discuss expanding AI's role in military cooperation. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: Gandhi vows to step up pressure on Modi at protest rally
entries.snippet: Rahul Gandhi said the removal of election chief Gyanesh Kumar will be the first step to getting the country on the right track. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Kimi Antonelli makes history as youngest F1 champion
entries.snippet: Kimi Antonelli became Formula One's youngest world champion and Italy's first since 1953 when he finished third in Sunday's thrilling and crash-hit Mexico City Grand Prix.

entries.title: South Korea to pour billions into AI
entries.snippet: President Lee Jae Myung has presented his record-breaking budget proposal for 2027, including major investments in AI and other tech.

entries.title: Ukraine, Russia report hacking attacks on emergency alert apps
entries.snippet: Ukraine and Russia have both reported cyberattacks targeting applications used to send emergency alerts to the public. Meanwhile, Zelenskyy said Ukraine will stop refinery strikes if the US sends Patriot missiles.

entries.title: German police investigating after needles found in Halloween candy
entries.snippet: German police said they received phone calls with reports about sharp objects concealed in Halloween candy.

entries.title: Russia's giant new radar in Kaliningrad raises alarm in NATO
entries.snippet: Russia is nearing completion of what experts think is a giant radar complex in Kaliningrad, capable of monitoring much of Europe. Experts warn the project could intensify the military standoff between Moscow and NATO.

entries.title: Serbia: Police chief arrested for abuse of office
entries.snippet: Marko Kricak, an Aleksandar Vucic loyalist, is accused of suppressing and manipulating an investigation into a gangland murder. Prosecutors say the arrest is not linked to Vucic's recent election defeat.

entries.title: France opens attempted murder probe after protest attack
entries.snippet: Paris prosecutors have opened an attempted murder investigation after a Molotov attack on police. France reported 779 arrests during nationwide protests and Halloween night, fewer than on previous weekends.

entries.title: Ukraine: Six-day localized ceasefire in Oleshky comes to end
entries.snippet: A US-brokered ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region ended on Sunday night with no violations reported. But Russian airstrikes continued in other parts of Ukraine.

entries.title: Ethnic Germans in Kazakhstan face legacy of the Soviet Union
entries.snippet: Kazakhstan is struggling to deal with the legacy of the Soviet dictatorship. Some 85 years ago, Stalin deported hundreds of thousands of people: Some 400,000 ethnic Germans living in the USSR were sent to Kazakhstan.

entries.title: Germany news: Gen Z group calls for new protests
entries.snippet: The group behind German demonstrations this weekend has called for more protests to keep pressure on the government to act. Meanwhile, the IG Metall union has begun warning strikes after pay talks collapse. DW has more.

entries.title: Biological weapons: The weaponization of disease
entries.snippet: Biological weapons are prohibited under international law. But new developments in biotech and AI are a cause for concern. DW addresses some of the most important questions about their history, risks, and control.

entries.title: Portugal police storm housing protest camps in Lisbon, Porto
entries.snippet: Clashes broke out as officers again dispersed housing protesters from tent camps in Lisbon and Porto. Portuguese police have repeatedly cleared tent camps erected across both cities in recent weeks.

entries.title: India news: Opposition holds major rally in Delhi over voter roll revisions
entries.snippet: Thousands are expected to take part in the Indian opposition's planned mega march in New Delhi over a controversial revision of electoral rolls.
